description: Official GifSnap 0.1.2 Kotlin coroutine API client and animated GIF/sticker picker for Jetpack Compose. Install from GifSnap's hosted Maven repository. Canonical source: https://github.com/rowixgroup/gifsnap-android.
rules: Add Maven repository https://gifsnap.com/sdk/android for group com.rowix.gifsnap. Install com.rowix.gifsnap:gifsnap-compose:0.1.2 or gifsnap-client:0.1.2 for custom UI. GifSnap is not on Maven Central or JitPack.

Import com.rowix.gifsnap.client.GifSnapClient and com.rowix.gifsnap.compose.GifSnapPicker. Keep the client with remember or a longer-lived owner; pass client and onSelect to the picker in a bounded-height container.

The Compose picker requires Android API 28+; the client alone supports API 23+. Use Kotlin 2.2.10+, Java bytecode target 17, compileSdk 36+ and a Compose-enabled host. Follow the README for the tested toolchain.
onSelect returns the original GifItem. Use gif.url for full animated media; previews may be static. The host controls sending and dismissal. The picker plays GIF and animated WebP, not video.

Call suspend search(query, mediaType, page, limit) or trending(mediaType, page, limit) from a coroutine. Follow pagination.nextPage. Preserve IDs, complete URLs and source metadata; client responses are not deduplicated.

The default API is https://gifsnap.com/api/v1 and currently needs no key. Handle cancellation, failures and rate limits. SDK code is MIT licensed; API availability and media rights are separate. No SLA is promised.

HTTP JSON uses next_page, has_next, preview_url and content_id. Kotlin properties are nextPage, hasNext, previewUrl and contentId. Follow docs/client-reference.md; do not use Kotlin property names in raw HTTP fixtures.
